About.title: A friendly spot for everyday life.
About.p1: Sercli opened in 2024 in Ferencváros with one goal: to be a place worth stopping at – for a coffee, lunch, or just a quiet moment.
About.p2: Whether you're heading to work, meeting someone, or just need a break – there's always a table waiting for you.

Menu.title: Fresh. Homemade. Every day.
Menu.subtitle: Fresh ingredients, made with care – every day.

Rendezveny.title: We're happy to bring Sercli to you.
Rendezveny.description: Whether it's a company lunch, team day or a smaller gathering – we put together the menu to suit you. Fresh, homemade food and reliable service.

Rendezveny.title: Small venue, big moments.
Rendezveny.p1: Team building, birthday, private brunch or an evening gathering – Sercli is the perfect spot for something intimate yet special.
Rendezveny.p2: We help with the menu, drink pairings, and can arrange a projector or sound system if needed. The vibe is always relaxed, the service personal.
Rendezveny.p3: Drop us a few lines about the occasion, group size and date – we'll get back to you within one working day.
Rendezveny.timeslot_value: Morning brunch, afternoon coffee, private evening event
Rendezveny.quote_desc: Send us an email or message us on Messenger and we'll sort out the details.
Rendezveny.footnote: In your email, include the occasion, group size, preferred date and a rough idea of the menu. We'll reply within one working day.

Contact.title: Come in, write or call.
Contact.description: Sercli is a friendly mid-sized café and bistro in Ferencváros. Whether you'd like to book a table, organise an event or just have a question about the menu – reach us through the channels below.
Contact.card_desc: Whether you want to book a table, ask about the menu or plan an event – a short message is all it takes for us to get back to you.
Contact.card_footnote: If it's urgent, give us a call – we're always reachable during opening hours.
